decision.commit_purpose: Correctness fix, reusable independent diff gate, and a reproducible negative retrieval checkpoint; no retrieval-default promotion

protocol.combination: Registered round-robin with exact thread deduplication and at most 100 candidates per lane
protocol.oracle_control: Best individual lexical arm is diagnostic only, not an implementable ranking policy
protocol.blindness_limit: Initial source catalog and some inputs were inspected. A legal native-response parsing failure was corrected after held-out evaluation began; no case was removed and no relevance parameter was tuned.

results.metric: Cases with an explicitly linked, merged reference PR in the unique-thread candidate budget; not exhaustive recall or demonstrated fix success

evidence_review.all_four_reference_landings: Merged after the reported version, descendants of that version, and ancestors of the frozen upper commit; exact closing and landing sources were verified

9832.inspection: PR 10169 suppresses GPTQ quantization for Qwen2-VL vision modules. The selected first log includes a Windows temporary-file PermissionError and registry failure. The issue title concerns unexpected GPTQ weights, but the closing link does not establish a fix for the extracted error episode.
9832.label_policy: Retained in the registered denominator, with direct applicability explicitly uncertain

6910.inspection: PR 6930 replaces the PaliGemma projector's sharded ColumnParallelLinear with nn.Linear. This is source-consistent with the reported tensor-width mismatch, without an executed runtime reproduction.
6910.native_edge: PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration.forward CALLS merge_vision_embeddings at paligemma.py:259; CBM reports confidence 0.97 and strategy lsp_callable_alias
6910.topology_limit: The caller file is already present in the traceback. This does not prove incremental coverage beyond raw stack coordinates.

19909.inspection: The benchmark invokes an outdated Marlin argument layout; PR 19929 updates the benchmark caller, including the missing argument positions and scalar-type handling. The terminal failure is in _custom_ops.py, which the PR does not modify.
19909.symbol_limit: The upper-symbol control uses the upper snapshot's interval and same qualified name, not a proven continuous lineage

16655.inspection: PR 16618 corrects GLM4 residual/layer-normalization handling and tuple unpacking, consistent with Tensor-versus-tuple failure in the log. Its unrelated model-name documentation edit also happens to retrieve the PR.
16655.query_term_origin: The vLLM token occurs inside an environment directory in the serialized traceback
16655.binding_judgment: A real documentation edit and exact source pointer do not validate the environment-path-to-document-title association; the sole hybrid gain is not accepted as a sound entity link

compatibility_fix.failure: The first held-out entity query returned Folder rows with empty line strings, causing the compact-row decoder to raise ValueError before any ranking
compatibility_fix.native_contract: Nodes without positive line information emit an empty display
compatibility_fix.fix: Decode empty coordinates as zero; preserve the node and retain existing Git-file membership checks, so folders do not become file histories

gates.digest_encoding: sha256(json.dumps(logical_result, sort_keys=True).encode()); remove run seconds, case seconds, case query_seconds, and generated seconds when present

cost.interpretation: These component runs include projection, verification and unchanged diagnostic arms, including rejected broad arms. They are not optimized warm query latency or a single measured end-to-end pipeline. Source pulls and other machine work continue concurrently.

limitations: Only four availability-biased held-out cases from one repository; no cross-repository effectiveness or statistical significance claim.
Closing links and issue-level titles need error-episode relevance auditing. Removing a mismatched case after seeing results would change the registered test.
Recorded static-edge predicates and exact Git/source checks do not prove semantic indexing completeness, runtime identity or causality.
The broad stack and upper-symbol results are exploratory diagnostics here, not a post-hoc replacement for the frozen policy.
No real agent, GPU execution, native C modification, source write, push or merge.

next.hypothesis: A small downstream landing index can eliminate repeated full GitHub payload scans without changing candidate sets, ranking or provenance
next.measured_motivation: Five requested commits cause 58,035 payload decodes. Frozen selection takes about 9 seconds and the profiled landing lookup about 19 seconds; complete pull and pull-git payloads total about 158 MB compressed.
next.implementation_boundary: Rebuild only from the frozen offline GitHub facts into a new disposable downstream SQLite index. Preserve pull-git preference, exact SHA-to-PR links, source observation IDs, digests and JSON pointers. No source writes or production query API redesign.
gates: Equality with the scanning implementation over all observed landing targets and recorded development query sets, including absent targets
Synthetic latest-incomplete, publication-cutoff, ordering-tie, unmerged, duplicate-source, corruption and source-boundary tests
Exact per-hit canonical-source verification with no older-complete fallback
Replay-equal candidates and source pointers; no ranking or held-out relevance tuning
Separate one-time construction from repeated lookup costs; report index size and peak resource usage
next.later_relevance_work: Use fresh development experiments for span- and node-kind-aware entity candidates and contextual stack evidence. Do not silently reuse this held-out checkpoint as an untouched test after learning from it.
